question: Should OpenClaw sponsor real-time multi-operator dashboard presence as part of the bundled modular dashboard roadmap, and what operator identity/editing data may be exposed to connected dashboard users?
rationale: The feature depends on an unmerged dashboard stack and exposes operator activity, so automation cannot choose the product, privacy, and scope boundary safely.

options.title: Keep As Wave 2 Dashboard Task
options.body: Preserve this issue as the focused follow-up and implement it only after the dashboard foundation lands with a reviewed identity, scope, TTL, and privacy contract.

options.title: Fold Into The Roadmap Tracker
options.body: Track presence only under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 if maintainers do not want separate dashboard subtask issues open yet.

options.title: Move Outside Bundled Dashboard
options.body: Require the presence experiment to live in an external plugin path if the bundled modular dashboard direction is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Keep As Wave 2 Dashboard Task
recommendation.body: Preserve this issue as the focused follow-up and implement it only after the dashboard foundation lands with a reviewed identity, scope, TTL, and privacy contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the plugin-tab and presence infrastructure that would constrain this product decision.
